81230.subject: [Legal Notice] Updates to Google Cloud Terms of Service and AI guidelines
81230.body:
Review the updated Google Cloud terms of service effective Oct 12, 2026.




MY CONSOLE




Hello Oleg,

We have updated the Google Cloud Terms of Service, Google Cloud Platform  
Service Specific Terms (SST), and SecOps Service Specific Terms (SST) and  
introduced the Google Cloud Agentic AI Responsible Use Guidelines,  
effective October 12, 2026.

These changes clarify your and our responsibilities regarding the  
deployment and management of AI agents by and within your organization.

We have provided additional details below to guide you through these  
updates.

What you need to know

Key changes:


Agentic AI Service-Specific Terms: In light of our introduction of  
long-running agents and other new agentic offerings, we have updated  
Sections 14, 15, 19, and 20 of the Google Cloud Platform Service Specific  
Terms and Sections 7 and 11 of the SecOps Service Specific Terms to clarify  
positions on intellectual property ownership and liability when interacting  
with different types of AI agents.
Google Cloud Agentic AI Responsible Use Guidelines: These new guidelines  
supplement our Acceptable Use Policy and Generative AI Prohibited Use  
Policy. They provide guardrails, restrictions, and recommendations to help  
you mitigate emerging agentic risks, protect user privacy, and facilitate  
the safe deployment of AI agents as the technology continues to evolve.
Google Cloud Terms of Service: We have updated Sections 3.3 and 13.2 of the  
online Google Cloud Terms of Service to clarify that our use restrictions  
apply to your AI agents and to include an indemnity of Google if your AI  
agents violate our Acceptable Use Policy.
Additional updates: On September 2, 2026, we added language to the  
following:

Section 2.4: We may suspend your services if you use a  
delayed-authorization form of payment (such as ACH) and we determine that  
you pose a risk of non-payment; and
Section 8.3: We can terminate the agreement immediately if you breach the  
agreement in a manner we determine is incapable of being cured.
Note: These changes will not impact any customers with offline agreements  
for Google Workspace.


What you need to do

Action required:


Review the applicable updated terms: Access the Google Cloud Platform  
Service Specific Terms, SecOps Service Specific Terms, and Google Cloud  
Terms of Service, as applicable.
Read the guidelines: Access the Google Cloud Agentic AI Responsible Use  
Guidelines.
Update internal policies: Align your current internal policies to these  
updated terms and deployment guardrails.

Note: Your continued use of AI features is subject to these updated terms.

We are here to help

If you have questions regarding these changes, please contact your Google  
Account Manager or Google Cloud Support.

Thank you for choosing Google Cloud.





– The Google Cloud Team





SUPPORT




© 2026 Google LLC 1600 Amphitheatre

81226.subject: Pump.fun Bets on Dubious Celebrity Trader to Reach the Mainstream
81226.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Pump.fun**](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/kimchi-coin-minted-before-pump-fun-ad-fee-routing)[ ran a Kimchi coin ad 78 seconds after mint](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/kimchi-coin-minted-before-pump-fun-ad-fee-routing)

* [**NSA**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/nsa-urges-php-users-to-patch-or-take-systems-offline)[ urges PHP patching or offline systems](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/nsa-urges-php-users-to-patch-or-take-systems-offline)

* [**Ledger**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ledger-adds-morpho-loans-against-wrapped-bitcoin)[ adds Morpho loans against wrapped bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ledger-adds-morpho-loans-against-wrapped-bitcoin)

* [**PancakeSwap**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/pancakeswap-opens-the-flip-vote-with-cake-supply-condition)[ votes on an 88% LP fee share](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/pancakeswap-opens-the-flip-vote-with-cake-supply-condition)

* [**OCC**](https://thedefiant.io/converge/regulation/occ-finalizes-genius-act-rule-drops-third-party-yield-presumption)[ finalizes GENIUS rule, drops yield presumption](https://thedefiant.io/converge/regulation/occ-finalizes-genius-act-rule-drops-third-party-yield-presumption)

Pump.fun wants customers who have never heard of a bonding curve. On Tuesday it signed Kimchi, a pseudonymous trader who claims about $40 million of profit on the TRUMP token, as a creative partner, and posted an ad for a Kimchi coin 78 seconds after the coin was minted. Co-founder Alon Cohen said the platform's next wave of users "does not come from CT."

The push makes sense, because the memecoin market no longer hands Pump.fun its users by default. Launchpads on Robinhood Chain [cut its share of launchpad fees](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/pump-fun-launchpad-fee-share-falls-robinhood-chain-pons-noxa) from 79% to 27% in two weeks this summer, and it climbed back above half by mid-August. Flap, a BNB Chain launchpad, [passed it in daily revenue](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/flap-overtakes-pump-fun-in-daily-revenue-with-1-18-million) on Aug. 1. Fomo, a trading app with copy trading and Apple Pay signup, [competes for the trade rather than the mint](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/fomo-s-record-revenue-week-still-trails-axiom-hyperliquid-and-pump-fun), and earned $19 million over the last 30 days against Pump.fun's $45.4 million. Pump.fun has answered by widening its app: [callout rewards tied to followers' profits](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/pump-fun-to-tie-callout-rewards-to-followers-profits), coins priced in tokenized stocks, and this week [pre-IPO tokens](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/pump-fun-adds-pre-ipo-tokens-to-its-launch-pairings). A famous face is the next move.

The ads got a lot of backlash, but I think the message was right. People come to a memecoin launchpad for a shot at getting rich quickly, and an ad that says so is honest about what the product sells. The cars-a

81225.subject: Urgent: Railway Security Disclosure - Rotate Credentials
81225.body:
Railway Logo

Earlier this morning, Railway detected anomalous activity involving systems that store customer environment variables. After further investigation, our investigation to date indicates that an unauthorized third party may have accessed encrypted environment variables and, for some of them, obtained the decrypted contents. Environment variables may contain secrets such as API keys or database and registry credentials.

We believe this is part of a series of attacks recently targeting platform companies with the aim of compromising AI inference providers. We have notified these upstream providers to revoke all keys proactively, as we take these kinds of events extremely seriously.

What you should do

* Immediately revoke and reissue all environment variables, including any API keys, stored in Railway.
* If you have any credentials on an external registry, .
* Review logs for those services for unusual activity.

Until builds are restored, you will not be able to roll out new versions. We apologize for this inconvenience. Follow this incident ( https://status.railway.com/incident/QH8L8B3E?utm_campaign=Security+Disclosure%3A+Wednesday+October+21st&utm_content=Security+Disclosure%3A+Wednesday+October+21st&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) to be notified when builds resume and for further updates.

We will provide new updates on this announcement, and on status.railway.com ( https://status.railway.com?utm_campaign=Security+Disclosure%3A+Wednesday+October+21st&utm_content=Security+Disclosure%3A+Wednesday+October+21st&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io ) as we gather all facts about the scope of impact.

Manage email preferences ( https://railway.com/account/notifications?utm_campaign=Security+Disclosure%3A+Wednesday+October+21st&utm_content=Security+Disclosure%3A+Wednesday+October+21st&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io )
